model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for multiple conditions. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick labels every 20000 units. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” with a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. The first line, colored purple and labeled “Vanilla,” begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.55 by the final iteration. The second line, colored orange and labeled “StrmLLM (n=64),” begins at approximately 3.2 and decreases to approximately 2.52 by the final iteration. The third line, colored green and labeled “SepLLM (n=64),” begins at approximately 3.2 and decreases to approximately 2.53 by the final iteration. The fourth line, colored magenta and labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," starts at around 3.2 and declines to about 2.52 at the end of the x-axis. The fifth line, colored dark blue and labeled “SepLLM (n=128),” begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.54 by the final iteration.
